messages:
sam: Heads-up — getting a bunch of customer reports about 403s hitting inference API since ~13:07 UTC. Looks widespread, not just one tenant. seeing ~10-15% error rate spike in our metrics. anyone on auth side?
pranav: oncall here, I'm looking. dashboards show a big queue length increase on api-key-validator (queue_depth ~ 12k). correlates with the 403 spike. digging into worker failures.
elaine: Support: multiple customers reported immediate 403s on every request, example customer A and customer B. They include the same API key that used to work. attaching sample curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete` -> 403.
jen: ingress: no recent LB config changes, healthchecks for auth-proxy are green. I can scale auth-proxy but if validator backlog is the cause, that won't help.
kyle: SRE: checking k8s. `kubectl get pods -n auth` shows api-key-validator pods are OOMKilled recently, one restarted 4x in last 10m. logs show: `rate_limit_exceeded` followed by `panic: nil pointer` in rate limiter path. past deployment of rate-limiter lib 2.3.1 rolled out at 12:55 UTC.
maria: eng-runtime: we rolled a small dependency bump to the validator last deploy today. didn't expect it to change queue handling, but code path touched the async worker. PR 3421 touched the bounded queue impl.
ops-bot: DeployBot: rollout complete for service=api-key-validator version=release-2026-03-15-2 at 12:56:10 UTC. No automatic rollback triggered.
pranav: hypothesis: new bounded-queue behavior + spike in auth checks caused workers to drop connections and return 403 as fallback. need to confirm whether 403 originates at validator or upstream. can someone tail full logs for a single request id?
elaine: pasted one request trace from customer A: `request_id=abc123` -> auth-proxy forwarded to validator, validator returned 403 with body 'api_key_revoked' but our key DB shows key active. weird.
jen: grabbing logs: `kubectl logs api-key-validator-5fd7 -n auth --since=15m` snippet: ```[13:07:12] WARN queue: enqueue failed, queue full
[13:07:12] ERROR handler: returning 403 fallback, err=failed to acquire token-handler
[13:07:12] INFO gc: dropping stale task```
kyle: rolling back validator to previous image (release-2026-03-14-9). initiating rollback now with `kubectl set image deployment/api-key-validator api-key-validator=release-2026-03-14-9 -n auth`.
ops-bot: DeployBot: triggered rollback for service=api-key-validator to release-2026-03-14-9 by kyle at 13:18:45 UTC.
pranav: after rollback, queue_depth back to normal within 2 min. error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.6% around 13:21 UTC. can we confirm customers restored?
elaine: support: customers A & B confirm requests succeed again. I'll send customer comms with timeline and root cause once we have RCA.
maria: we should open a revert PR for the queue change and add more backpressure metrics + circuit breaker before merge. PR 3421 will be reverted; ENG owners assigned: maria + devtools.
sam: summary: incident caused by a change to the bounded queue/worker behavior in api-key-validator that couldn't handle a short traffic surge, causing workers to drop tasks and surface 403 fallbacks. action items: (1) revert PR 3421 (maria), (2) add queue fullness alert and SLI for validator backpressure (kyle), (3) postmortem + customer comms (elaine). tagging oncall for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
pranav: filing incident ticket now and will mark Sev2, adding logs/metrics and timeline.
ops-bot: IncidentBot: incident/INC-2026-0315-009 created by pranav, severity=2, incident-channel=#incidents/2187654321.
